nanchang-2019.notes: Source 2 (XCPCIO) prints the start as 2019-11-10 19:00 CST and the end as 2019-11-11 00:00 CST, while the pack gives 2019-11-29; contest_date left null. Only 32 team rows of the XCPCIO board are filled in our copy (300 empty rows follow). Problem G is 'Hamster and Eating' on QOJ (source 4) and 'Eating Plan' on Luogu (source 12) and in the pack. The Luogu pages hold machine-translated Chinese statements without samples in the page text.
